subject: R script using ggplot2 does not produce usable pdf with pdf graphics device

messages.author: bd6dda60d4cdf0ef
messages.subject: R script using ggplot2 does not produce usable pdf with pdf graphics device
parts:
Hi,

Consider
############################################################
foo.R
############################################################
makegg <- function()
{
library(ggplot2)
pdf(file = "foo.pdf", width = 4, height = 4)
carrots <- data.frame(length = rnorm(100000, 6, 2))
cukes <- data.frame(length = rnorm(50000, 7, 2.5))
carrots$veg <- 'carrot'
cukes$veg <- 'cuke'
vegLengths <- rbind(carrots, cukes)
ggplot(vegLengths, aes(length, fill = veg)) + geom_density(alpha =
0.2)
dev.off()
}

makegg()
############################################################

This does not produce a usable pdf. However, if I remove the function and
put all statements in global scope, it works fine.

I'm using

Rscript foo.R

I'm on Debian squeeze with ggplot2 0.8.9 and R 2.14.2. What am I doing
wrong, if anything? Please cc me on any reply. Thanks.

Regards, Faheem

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: RE: R script using ggplot2 does not produce usable pdf with pdf graphics device
parts:
Or use ggsave() to create the pdf. Much easier.

makegg <- function()
{
library(ggplot2)

carrots <- data.frame(length = rnorm(100000, 6, 2))
cukes <- data.frame(length = rnorm(50000, 7, 2.5))
carrots$veg <- 'carrot'
cukes$veg <- 'cuke'
vegLengths <- rbind(carrots, cukes)

p <- ggplot(vegLengths, aes(length, fill = veg)) + geom_density(alpha =
0.2)
ggsave(p, file = "foo.pdf", width = 4, height = 4)
}

makegg()
